verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP documentation lists "Search emails with custom queries" and "Filter emails by labels", which shows a basic search-and-filter capability. The GitHub note about storing emails in Durable Objects and R2 "to speed things up" hints at performance but says nothing specific about search. Missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked or relevance-sorted results, explicit coverage of full mail history, any evidence of in-app search UI speed or precision, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
